files.observation: Kimi Chat normalizes local refs and aliases; native Claude schema compatibility is not established
Synthetic roundtripper tests contain nested refs, sibling type and highspeed cases; not vendor receipts
Reference expansion has a 256 KiB cap but degrades cycles/overflow to hints; weakening is not adopted

scope.credentialRail: one bound Account with account-scoped device identity
scope.copilotResourceScope: exact Account, both token generations, GitHub domain and validated API origin; no protocol change

localPolicy.parent: existing process ResidentMemoryBudget; logical allocation/index estimate, not RSS

replay.owner: copied Bytes::from_owner allocation with reservation until final clone/slice drop
replay.refusal: optional retention omitted; CAS replacement removes old snapshot; no retry, refresh, relogin or cooldown

catalogs.owner: shared immutable payload owns reservation through last Arc snapshot
catalogs.refusal: authoritative replacement removes old entry including stale; Copilot admission returns local 503, Kimi discovery returns capacity-unavailable
catalogs.fetchOwner: body and transient parse are admitted before allocation; fetched payload carries its reservation across async identity checks and transfers it to the shared published owner

localPolicy.singleflight: bounded per-cache registrations plus each guard/waiter reservation; cancellation and cache deletion preserve live charges
localPolicy.streamReplay: optional bounded accumulator with transient JSON estimate; capacity abandons only replay retention; complete output owns its Bytes reservation

schema.scope: Kimi Chat tools[].function.parameters and legacy functions[].parameters after generic conversion; Claude native input_schema unchanged
schema.references: local literal JSON Pointer only; nested refs and conjunctive siblings preserved
schema.refusal: recursive, unresolved, remote or scoped refs rejected locally without typed-hint weakening

localPolicy.models: existing authenticated catalog intersected with reviewed default/highspeed/K3 aliases; no broad prefix or 1m fallback

cases.expect: charge survives expiry/index deletion until final Bytes slice drops
Kimi and Copilot charge survives eviction until final shared snapshot drops
old authorization is removed; external owner keeps its charge; no stale revival
one same-key flight; each waiter charged, cancellation releases only its owner

cases.input: 32 local refs each expanding a 16 KiB description

cases.expect: no replay/catalog reuse across token, identity or runtime generation
only authenticated highspeed model authorizes its exact reviewed alias
